title: Clone cleanup: remaining Arc<str> tiers and borrow-checker fixes
description:
Remaining items from the clone audit (clone-to-owned file). Waves 1-2 landed in ebc0ce3 and 9eaec5d (SymbolRow/FileRow identity fields, Convention/Constraint identity fields → Arc<str>). Tier 3 landed in 7fc6ecd (Convention antecedent/consequent → Arc<[String]>). Tier 4 landed in 49ee318 (HashMap lookup maps → borrowed &str).

What's left:

**Tier 5 — Borrow-checker fights (~8 sites)**
- engine.rs: self.rebuild(&self.symbol_attrs.clone()) — partial-borrow workaround
- engine.rs: self.conventions.clone() returned from &mut self — return &[Convention]
- rules.rs: self.constraint.clone().into_iter() — just .iter()
- trace.rs: track Vec<i64> instead of Vec<(i64, Arc<str>)>, resolve names at output

**Tier 6 — Test clones**
~23 sites in similarity/ tests — low priority, test clarity > zero-copy.
execution_record: Landed tiers 5 in three commits: (1) trace.rs — replaced Vec<(i64, Arc<str>)> DFS stacks with Vec<i64> + HashMap<i64, Arc<str>> side table for deferred name resolution, eliminating per-edge Arc clones and making stack snapshots cheap. (2) rules.rs — changed all_constraints(&self) to (&mut self) + mem::take, eliminating full Vec<RawConstraint> clone. (3) engine.rs — changed rebuild/rebuild_with_params/update_incremental to return () instead of Vec<Convention>, callers use conventions() accessor; collapsed two Vec clones into one in the pipeline path. Site 1 (symbol_attrs.clone() partial-borrow workaround) skipped — no net savings without an API split since rebuild_with_params does to_vec() internally anyway. Tier 6 (~23 test clones in similarity/) skipped — test clarity over zero-copy."
